text:
sarah_m: Quick assign for postmortem follow-ups on the GPU/autoscale spike. We need concrete owners for: short-term throttles, pre-warm pool, scheduler priority, simulator runs, alerts, and customer comms. Keep replies short with ETA.

mike_g: I'll run simulator experiments (cold-cache bursts + different cooldowns). Plan: baseline vs more-aggressive scale-up (75->62) and cooldown 5m->90s. Will report p99, scale events, and cost impact (estimating ~+8%). ETA: 48h.

anya: I'll revise the postmortem doc and add an emergency runbook section (commands to enable TTL pre-warm pool, how to flip per-tenant soft-throttles). Draft PR by tomorrow midday.

leo_ops: I'll prototype scheduler change: add priorityClass "realtime-infer" and a reclaim policy to prefer preempting batch/best-effort. Also will add an infra flag reserved_pool_percent (default 0). PR + infra ticket by next Wed.

olivia_pm: Monitoring need: a lead indicator "alloc_mismatch_ratio" and alert when predicted capacity deviates >15% for 2m. Block canary until alerts exist. I'll own alert definitions. ETA: before canary.

infra-bot: Reminder: node image rollout Thursday 00:30-02:30 UTC. Avoid canary windows overlapping.

sarah_m: Short-term mitigation idea (product): soft per-tenant token buckets to limit bursty tenants. Jordan or product take this?

anya: I can draft policy + short customer note; will coordinate with @olivia_pm. Ready by tomorrow.

mike_g: Canary plan suggestion: 3% traffic, 6h window, automatic rollback on p99 regress or allocation alerts. Sam_s to own execution.

sarah_m: Owners recap for ticket: mike_g -> simulator & numbers (48h), leo_ops -> scheduler + reserved_pool flag (Wed), anya -> runbook + messaging (tomorrow), olivia_pm -> alerts (pre-canary). We'll meet Fri AM to review sims and decide canary. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
